title: libsbgnpy: python library for SBGN

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Faculty of Life Science, Institute for Biology, Biology, Berlin; University Lübeck; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
libsbgnpy is a python library to work with the Systems Biology Graphical Notation (SBGN) with source code available from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/libsbgnpy

Features include

  • python bindings of the SBGN-ML schema, generated with xsdata
  • reading and writing of SBGN documents, including SBGN-ML 0.1 and 0.2
  • notes, extensions and render information
  • validation against the SBGN XSD schema
  • rendering of maps as images

Documentation is available from https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/libsbgnpy. If you have any questions or issues please open an issue
